changelog:
gr-geo-cite v1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Introduces automated and manual workflows to track if Claude, GPT, Perplexity, or Gemini cite your domain for fixed weekly queries.
- Guides on boosting AI citation rates via llms.txt, FAQ Schema, and Citable Statistics blocks.
- Provides clear templates and anti-patterns for AI-friendly website structuring.
- Includes scoring script for measuring article citability and scripts for citation audit, Citable Stats injection, and llms.txt generation.
- Outlines triggers (“GEO citation”, “AI引用”, “llms.txt”, etc.) and actionable use-cases for citation tracking and optimization.
summary: GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) 引用追踪 + 优化。每周对 4 大 AI（Claude/GPT/Perplexity/Gemini） 跑固定查询，检测回答里是否引用 gingiris 域名。对未被引用的目标页补 Citable Statistics + llms.txt...
